summary: 10.0.41.09 Precision Fixes & Parity: Master Data 58px Compact KPI Ribbon Uniformity, Centralized Dynamic Table Layout & Reflow Authority, Recon Supplier & Purchase Recon Enterprise 2-Row Filter Toolbars & Centered Window Modals, Purchase Recon Add/Save Bug Fix, Settings Blank Screen Resolution, Purchase Creation Attachment Controls Parity, and Notification Center Header Badges Reset
highlights: 1. Universal 58px Compact KPI Ribbon: Standardized all 14 register and dashboard views to the Master Data golden standard (.compact-kpi-card, data-erp-kpi-compact-enhanced='true'), eliminating right-side blank space and enhancer refresh lockouts.

2. Centralized Dynamic Table Layout & Reflow: Installed sales-desktop-table wrapped in sales-table-card/sales-table-scroll with DynamicTableLayoutManager colgroup allocation, and hooked instant reflow into sidebar expand/collapse/hover.
3. Recon Supplier Toolbar & Centered Modal: Added standardized 2-row filter box (Search, Status, Source, Date From/To, Presets, Reset, Refresh) and replaced side drawer with centered window modal.
4. Purchase Recon Toolbar & Centered Modal: Replaced cramped single-row filter strip with standard 2-row filter box and converted side drawer into centered window modal dialog.

5. Purchase Recon Add/Save Bug Resolved: Resiliently parsed server page response (content/rows/array) and protected dialog/toast lifecycle, ensuring newly created records immediately display in register.

6. Settings Screen Blank Resolution: Mapped all left-sidebar view-settings-* sub-routes to monolithic views/settings.html before dispatching switchSection, completely fixing blank screen on navigation.

7. Purchase Creation Attachment Widget Parity: Standardized + Add / Replace, Preview, and Delete buttons and wired to controller methods with existingAttachmentPath initialization matching Quotation Editor.
8. Notification Center Badges Reset: Implemented clearCommunicationBadges() and dse_whatsapp_read_ack tracking, ensuring WhatsApp and Email counters reset to 0 upon viewing.
